title: ScalableRAG: High-Quality RAG with Exact Corpus Operations at Minimal Ingestion Cost
abstract: arXiv:2607.25135v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: RAG systems face a capability-cost gap: lightweight retrievers locate evidence but expose no operands for exact corpus-level operations (counts, intersections, aggregations), while knowledge ingestion systems obtain them only through expensive ingestion. ScalableRAG closes this gap with a persistent typed-set workspace: an agent builds named document and value sets at query time and composes them through set algebra, typed extraction, aggregation, and diagnostics.   Zero-Ingestion ScalableRAG needs no preprocessing, not even a vector index. It matches the leading baseline on four conventional QA benchmarks (74.75 versus 74.64) and on aggregative Hotels-50 beats every evaluated system, scoring 71.74: 36.23 above the leading baseline (SRAG), and 40.22 points above A-RAG. Removing the workspace drops Hotels-50 to 38.4. On Hotels-350, the partition SRAG itself reports on, ScalableRAG leads SRAG by 9.3 points. Limited-Ingestion ScalableRA

translated_title: ScalableRAG：以最小摄取成本实现精确语料库操作的高质量RAG
translated_abstract: RAG系统面临能力-成本差距：轻量级检索器能够定位证据，但不提供执行精确语料库级操作（计数、交集、聚合）所需的操作数，而知识摄取系统只有通过昂贵的摄取过程才能获得这些能力。ScalableRAG通过一个持久化的类型化集合工作区弥合了这一差距：智能体在查询时构建命名的文档集合和值集合，并通过集合代数、类型化抽取、聚合和诊断来组合它们。零摄取（Zero-Ingestion）ScalableRAG无需任何预处理，甚至不需要向量索引。它在四个传统问答基准上与领先的基线方法持平（74.75对74.64），而在聚合型Hotels-50基准上击败了所有被评估的系统，得分71.74：比领先的基线（SRAG）高出36.23分，比A-RAG高出40.22分。移除工作区会使Hotels-50的成绩降至38.4。在Hotels-350（SRAG本身报告的划分）上，ScalableRAG领先SRAG 9.3分。有限摄取（Limited-Ingestion）ScalableRAG……
tldr: ScalableRAG通过持久化的类型化集合工作区，让智能体在查询时利用集合代数执行精确的语料库级操作，无需任何预处理甚至向量索引，就能在聚合问答任务上大幅超越现有RAG系统。
en_tdlr: ScalableRAG introduces a persistent typed-set workspace that enables agents to perform exact corpus-level operations through set algebra at query time, requiring no preprocessing or vector index while dramatically outperforming existing RAG systems on aggregative QA tasks.
